title: Government Fund
subtitle: Finish your compliance steps to unlock up to R300,000 in support.
hero_anchor: The way to qualify is simple: finish your compliance steps. Each one you complete moves you closer to the fund.
status_green_title: You qualify — your compliance steps are done
status_green_desc: You've finished what the fund needs. You could receive up to R300,000 in grants and interest-free loans. Apply below.
status_amber_desc: Finish your remaining compliance steps to qualify. They're how you unlock up to R300,000 in support.
status_red_desc: You have {count} steps left before you can apply. Completing your compliance path is how you qualify — we'll walk you through each one.
eligibility_sa_citizen_hint: Set during onboarding. Foreign-born owners naturalised as SA citizens before 1994 also qualify.
eligibility_township_rural_label: Shop in township or rural area
eligibility_township_rural_hint: The fund only supports shops in townships or rural areas.
eligibility_owner_managed_hint: The fund requires the owner to run the shop day-to-day.
priority_subtitle: Some owners get priority when the fund reviews applications. Movestock doesn't store the youth or women answers — tick them on your SEDFA application.
priority_disability_hint: Tell us if you live with a disability — it gives your application priority.
priority_declared_hint: When you apply at spazashopfund.co.za, tick the matching priority groups so SEDFA flags your application.
eligibility_blocked_warning: The fund requires your shop to be in a township or rural area and owner-managed. You may not qualify.
doc_cipc_conditional_hint: Only needed if you want more than R80,000.
doc_sars_grace_hint: You're inside the six-month SARS grace window — SARS isn't blocking your application, but register before the window closes.
tier1_stock_desc: For buying initial stock through approved delivery partners.
tier1_infra_desc: For fridges, shelving, security, building upgrades (mix of grant and loan).
tier1_training_desc: POS systems, business skills, digital literacy, food safety.
tier1_cipc_unlock_hint: Company registration (CIPC) is needed for any funding above R80,000. Register to unlock Tier 2 (up to R300,000).
tier2_blended_title: Part grant, part loan: up to R250,000
pack_desc: Movestock will combine your business details, registration status, sales history and compliance records into one PDF.
pack_missing_hint: Complete {count} more documents first. The pack needs all your registrations.
apply_portal_url_hint: spazashopfund.co.za (run by NEF on behalf of SEDFA).
apply_in_person_desc: Visit your nearest SEDFA office. Bring your documents and ID.
sars_grace_countdown_body: You can apply for the fund without SARS registration until {date}. Register before then — once the window closes, you'll need SARS on file to stay ready.
apply_scam_warning_title: Beware fake fund forms and helpers
apply_scam_warning_body: SAnews has warned about fake assistants selling 'application forms' or offering to submit on your behalf. The fund application is FREE and ONLY available through spazashopfund.co.za, NEF, and SEDFA. Never pay anyone to apply for you.
tier_ladder_above_hint: Company registration (CIPC) required (you have 6 months after approval to register)
tier_ladder_cap_hint: Not available — R300,000 is the per-shop cap
